repo_notes.content: Treat this repository as a catalog of independent reusable n8n automations, NOT one monolithic application. Prioritize helping visitors discover, compare, import and configure workflows. Each workflow page must start with: What it does; Who it is for; Services required; How it works (brief ordered steps); Setup; Versions/variants; Security and limitations; Links to exact README and workflow JSON. Use the current repository files as source of truth; never invent nodes, features, prices, links, compatibility or release status. Differentiate downloadable free JSON, Gumroad listings, and staging or legacy variants. Cite exact repository paths and keep content concise and practical. Group variants under one solution rather than creating a page per internal file. Avoid excessive node-by-node details unless essential.
